name: Dang Vu (Matt)
paragraphs: I started as a developer trainee at FPT Software, where I learned that most of software is other people. Then I joined Bravebits and worked on PageFly, a page builder merchants use for their storefronts. I worked on both the frontend and the backend. I built tools that turn a screenshot or a Figma design into a real page, and I spent a lot of time making the app faster so it could meet Shopify's own quality bar.

Next came sending.ac, where a small team of good engineers built the product from the ground up. It was my first time at real startup pace: short sprints, decisions made in a day, everything up for grabs. I took features from nothing to working, and I was the one paged when they broke. That quietly changed how I write everything.
So that's how I work now: think about the people, and write code I'd be fine getting paged for.
In my free time I play with Rust, mostly by sending small patches to tensorzero and nextest.
